outgoing.name: Pope John Paul II
outgoing.excerpt: Both Pope John Paul II and Pope Benedict XVI have singled it out for high praise, and in 2002, Escrivá was canonized as a saint.

outgoing.excerpt: In 1950, Opus Dei was given final and complete approval by Pope Pius XII.
